title.narrative: European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) phase II: funding for 2024 work plan

description.narrative: 1. Support for an updated EDCTP Masters scholarship scheme for candidates from sub-Saharan Africa to attend relevant Master programmes in subject areas relevant to clinical research, epidemiology, clinical trials and global health, with an associated option for a further research or policy project 2. Scholarships for: (i) candidates from sub-Saharan Africa to attend the 2-week training programme, Advanced Course of Vaccinology (ADVAC) for scientists and decision-makers involved in vaccine development, new vaccination strategies or in associated policy areas (ii) Strengthening the EDCTP Regional Networks of Excellence through bioprocessing training

The UK Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) funds outstanding global health research through the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR). The NIHR provided funding to the European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) which aims to support collaborative research that accelerates the clinical development of new or improved interventions to prevent or treat poverty related as well as emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases affecting sub-Saharan Africa. NIHR has supported research capacity strengthening and training in sub-Saharan Africa, related to strengthening clinical trials capacity as part of the 2024 Workplan focussed on: • Support for an updated EDCTP Masters scholarship scheme for candidates from sub-Saharan Africa to undertake Masters degrees with an option for an associated project or policy activity • Support for candidates from sub-Saharan Africa to attend training specific to improving clinical trial capability in sub-Saharan Africa
